protocol.title: Functional: certificate cost of C_lucb versus Uniform on the group-range panel (prospective holdout)
protocol.gating: Execution is gated on F5.5 items 1, 2 and 4.  Items 1 and 2 are done (P28: 28/28 oracle agreement at R=2 and R=3, clean primal/dual certificates).  Item 4 is partially done (P26 v2).  This protocol is sealed now so that registration precedes any outcome.
protocol.target: For each relation r, C_r(mu) = max_a mu_ra - min_a mu_ra (full range, no factor 1/2).  The answer is Top_k of C(mu).  R = 5 relations, K = 6 actions, k = 2.
protocol.observation_law: Independent Gaussian scalar reads of cell (r,a) with unknown variance estimated from the samples themselves.  One sample = one unit of budget.
protocol.instrument_costs: Unit price per sample; NO setup cost in this run.  Setup-cost phases and primitive contrasts are a separate study and are not part of this protocol.
protocol.primary_hypothesis: C_lucb reaches a certificate at a strictly lower restricted mean sample cost than Uniform, paired by instance, at the stated horizon.
protocol.primary_endpoint: Restricted mean number of samples to certificate, truncated at the horizon H, paired by instance.
protocol.estimand: Paired difference (C_lucb - Uniform) of the restricted mean at H.
protocol.multiplicity: ONE primary endpoint.  Certificate fraction and false-safe rate are SECONDARY, reported with the same interval and explicitly labelled secondary; no alpha is spent on them and no secondary result may be promoted after the fact.
protocol.diagnostic_rule: C_extrema_oracle sees the truth.  It is reported separately and is NOT a performance ceiling and NOT a baseline.
protocol.generator: scripts/run_functional_variance_stopping_lab_v4.py, version fixed by the snapshot digest below
protocol.seed_policy: Seeds are fixed in this file BEFORE any outcome is observed and are not reused from tuning or method selection.  Choosing seeds by observed performance is prohibited; 'new seeds' means outcomes not used in tuning, not merely different numbers.
protocol.censoring: Instances that do not certify by H are censored at H and enter the restricted mean at H.  The censored fraction is reported per comparator.
protocol.failures_and_exclusions: No exclusions are planned.  Any run that raises is reported with its traceback and its instance id; it is never dropped silently.
protocol.stopping_rule: Fixed.  H samples per instance, no interim analyses, no adaptive stopping of the experiment, no peeking at the primary endpoint before all instances finish.
protocol.compute_cost_reporting: Wall seconds, peak RSS and total samples drawn, per comparator, recorded in run_receipt.json.
protocol.deviations_policy: Any deviation is recorded in run_receipt.json with its reason and its timestamp.  THIS FILE IS NEVER EDITED.
protocol.publication_of_this_file: None.  This script contacts no service and registers nothing; the user chooses whether and where to lodge the digest.

registration.how_to_register: Lodge `snapshot_digest` and this file's own sha256 with an independent timestamping service or registry (embargo if appropriate), then record the receipt in external_registration.json NEXT TO this file.  Do not edit this file.
registration.why_this_file_alone_is_not_enough: A local file and a local mtime prove content identity, not chronology.  Only an independent record predating outcome access establishes that the protocol came first.
